items.html: *Now the secret of the Daat of the head of the Long Face (Arich Anpin) is greatly hidden, and therefore it is in the secret of the mouth of the Ancient One (Atik), mentioned in the Zohar: "The Daat is hidden in the mouth." But its upper three [Sefirot] are in the secret of the encompassing light (Or Makif), because they cannot become clothed, as above. The Bina of Atik was not clothed at all. But illumination from it is drawn externally, reaching to the forehead of Arich Anpin. Also in the head of Arich Anpin there is its own Daat, and within it is the Yesod of Atik; and illumination also issues from the aforementioned Yesod, breaks through and goes out, and strikes the light of the Bina of Atik which is outside; and they strike one against the other — that which is inside goes out, and that which is outside enters in.
